Download VertexStealth for Windows

VertexStealth for Windows is an antidetect browser and multi-profile manager. It launches your installed Chrome or Firefox with separate profile folders, proxies and fingerprint settings.

Windows 10 / 11

How do I install VertexStealth on Windows?

  1. Install. Run the installer. You need Windows 10 or 11 and Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox already installed.
  2. Sign in. Create your VertexStealth account inside the app. New accounts start with a 3-day trial.
  3. Create a profile. Pick Chrome or Firefox, set a proxy if you need one, launch, and use Fingerprint Check to see what the browser reports.

What do you get with VertexStealth?

  • Isolated Chrome and Firefox profiles, each with its own cookies, storage and settings
  • A proxy per profile (HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5) with a built-in connection test
  • Configurable fingerprint settings, timezone and location that can follow the proxy, and WebRTC modes
  • A built-in Fingerprint Check, plus shortcuts to outside testers
  • A free plan with up to 3 profiles, and a 3-day trial without the limit

System requirements

  • Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox installed
  • An internet connection for sign-in and your plan
  • Optional: an HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 proxy for each profile

Learn more about VertexStealth as an antidetect browser and multi-profile management.

Frequently asked questions

Is VertexStealth free?

You can use VertexStealth for free with up to 3 browser profiles. New accounts also start with a 3-day trial without that limit.

Which browsers does it work with?

VertexStealth launches Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox, which must already be installed on your computer.

Is there a version for macOS or Linux?

Not yet. VertexStealth is a Windows 10 and 11 desktop app.

Do I need an account?

Yes. You create a VertexStealth account inside the app. Your browser profiles and browsing data stay on your computer.
